name: ArtworkLabelChangeTracker
tagline: Run every pharmaceutical artwork and label change across markets – proofs, sign-offs, printer release and first batch – against the regulatory deadline.
description: A complete plug-and-play Power Apps component for packaging artwork change control: impact assessment, artwork design, proof rounds with a configurable limit, Regulatory/QA/Marketing sign-off that is withdrawn when artwork returns to design, release to the printer and implementation with the first batch. Deadlines are derived from the health-authority approval date (safety vs. variation windows); a market matrix shows which countries block each global change and a timeline shows implementation against the deadlines. Works instantly with fictional demo data; connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel or SQL in canvas apps, to views in model-driven apps and to the Power Pages Web API.
features: 10 KPI tiles incl. on-time implementation and obsolete-stock write-off
Deadlines derived from HA approval (safety 90 / variation 180 days, configurable)
Proof rounds with limit warning and pre-proof checks
Three-function sign-off with automatic approval and withdrawal on rework
Release to printer blocked when the planned date is after the deadline
First batch and write-off recorded at implementation
One change per market in one step
Market matrix with one-click raise for missing markets
Bulk assess, assign, plan, hold, cancel, export
Phone layouts (cards, one stage at a time, agenda)
controlType: standard (2 controls: ArtworkLabelChangeTracker data-set + ArtworkLabelChangeTrackerPortal field control for Power Pages)
